Callback deliveries are signed with the `x-webhook-signature` header.

Each delivery has the shape:
```json
{
  "id": "stable-event-id",
  "eventType": "wallet.deposit.completed",
  "payload": {
    "userId": "user-uuid",
    "...": "event-specific fields"
  },
  "timestamp": "2026-04-08T10:24:00.000Z"
}
```

Event-specific payload fields can vary by provider. See the examples on the internal receive endpoint for concrete JSON bodies for every supported event type.

For signature verification code (Express and FastAPI examples) see [Webhooks and events](https://embedded.bmoni.com/docs/api-reference/webhooks#verify-every-delivery).
